answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 18912 Country: India Title: Touching the Quran in menses and reciting the verses with the intention of dua Question: At the time of periods they say that we should not even say any Arabic word or dua which we say commonly or touch any books related? is it like that or we can recite any particular dua or any restriction for any duas? Answer ID: 18912 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 123/123/M=1431) In the state of menses, it is only prohibited to touch the Quran and to recite it, but she can recite the duas mentioned in the Quran with the intention of dua as she can recite other duas and durood . She can touch the books of dua etc, only she will not touch the places where the Quranic verses are written. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
